review_notes.notes.1: Degree pathways require 40-45 quarter credits; no single credit count or tuition plan is selected. Do not convert quarter credits to semester credits.
review_notes.notes.2: Prerequisite deficiencies and below-3.0 GPA receive individual review; the preparatory topic list must not cause an exception-free automatic rejection. Coursework review is incomplete.

sources.fact_summary: Tacoma offers multiple 40-45 quarter-credit pathways. The page establishes Fall 2027, a July 31 final deadline subject to space, bachelor preparation and optional GRE. Deficiencies require individual review; a specific credit/tuition path is not selected.
sources.locator: Tacoma MSCSS / Quick Facts, Admissions and Degree Pathways

english.condition_below_recommended: Additional UW English requirements apply below the recommended score.

sources.fact_summary: UW policy gives IELTS 6.5 minimum, 7.0 recommended and a two-year validity period. Below-recommended scores carry additional requirements; university policy also describes other evidence paths not automated in this record.
